layers.text: Redraw him as a high-medieval man-at-arms: a gold-yellow band around the steel helmet under a deep crimson crest; a deep crimson red surcoat with a bold gold-yellow cross on the chest over steel chainmail sleeves; the top of a crimson heater shield with a gold-yellow lion at his shoulder. Keep the sword, the face, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
